value.rationale: This is the sharp effective discrimination law for a natural fixed-length subsequence-frequency sketch. It resolves a source-weighted entropy quantity not determined by simply counting possible profile types: for a fair binary source the order-two effective number is quadratic despite a cubic exact number of types. For unequal Bernoulli sources the exact exponential confusion rate is the squared one-letter Hellinger affinity, with a sharp \(n^{-2}\) prefactor.
